BanService.luau.description: Ban Service provides the service implementation used by the Banservice package. Public entry points include `BanService.Init`, `BanService.BanDurationAsync`, `BanService.BanPermanentlyAsync`, `BanService.UnbanAsync`, `BanService.IsBannedAsync`.
